How It Works

Simple. Fast. Lifesaving.

01
📝

Create Your Profile

Sign up and set your blood group, location, and gender. Takes less than 2 minutes.

02
🔍

Find or Request Blood

Post a blood request or browse available donors filtered by blood group and location.

03
🩸

Connect & Donate

Get matched, see the route on a live map, chat with the requester, and donate.

Features

Everything You Need

🗺️

Live Map Routing

See the exact route from the donor's area to the hospital on an interactive map.

♀️

Gender-Safe Matching

Female patients see female donors listed first for a safer, more comfortable experience.

💬

Direct Messaging

Chat directly with donors or requesters instantly after matching.

🔔

Blood Appeals

Directly appeal to specific donors for urgent needs with a single click.

📊

Admin Dashboard

Full analytics with charts: donation trends, gender ratios, blood group stats and more.

⚡

Real-time Updates

Blood requests and volunteer responses update instantly thanks to Supabase.
